functional_requirements: Transmit rotation from an input shaft to an output shaft with a total speed reduction of 1:10
Compose the train from at least two distinct gear types (spur and helical)
unknowns: Helix angle for the helical stage
assumptions: Deterministic surrogate CAD is used; gear tooth geometry is not generated (no 'gear' DSL op exists)
Gear blanks are modeled as cylinders on parallel z-axes; the 1:10 ratio is realized by pitch radii
Compound train uses three parallel shafts (input, intermediate, output)
